flows.name: A team keeps an agent's behaviour under control in production (LaunchDarkly)
flows.summary: LaunchDarkly's home page, in its own terms: an agent's prompts, models and tools are configurations released like features; LaunchDarkly watches cost, toxicity and satisfaction, steers responses in real time and rolls back or remediates a misbehaving agent, without a person if set so.

steps.what: Put the agent's configuration (prompts, models, tools) under AgentControl, with variations to test in production.
Runs in production on the configuration LaunchDarkly serves it.
Monitors the agent (cost, toxicity, satisfaction) and routes traffic to the best prompt or model.
Steers responses in real time and remediates a misbehaving agent or failing code automatically, "without human intervention", or rolls the change back.
